svg.title: A790 · One printer; sharing remembered choices

g.text: A790 · One printer; sharing remembered choices
G agreed · H is one question · design only
G · Agreed: suggest the sole available printer
Restaurante Olivo S.L.
Newly opened form · Harbour F/1042 Receipt
Previous printer unavailable
Bar receipt is disabled
Only eligible printer · preselected
Patio receipt
Final named confirmation still required
Print a copy on Patio receipt
First use: select the sole eligible printer without inventing a previous-printer warning. Nothing prints or changes memory merely on opening. G does not replace an
open selection or reroute a submitted request.
Cancel
Example only · no printing
H · Recommended: share in this browser
Restaurante Olivo S.L.
Luis signs in after Ana · same browser / venue
Earlier: Luis printed on Bar receipt
Later: Ana printed on Patio receipt
Server accepted Ana’s Patio request
Ana logs out; Luis signs in
Luis opens Receipt · Patio selected
Print a copy on Patio receipt
Both Bar and Patio are still eligible to Luis. Shared memory keeps the last accepted destination at this workstation. Only eligible choices may be shown; memory
grants no permission. Invoice and Hillside remain separate.
Cancel
Example only · no printing
H · Alternative: each person’s own choice
Restaurante Olivo S.L.
Same accepted prints · same browser / venue
Luis’s earlier accepted printer
Bar receipt
Ana’s later accepted printer
Patio receipt
Luis opens Receipt · Bar selected
Print a copy on Bar receipt
Personal memory restores Luis’s choice instead of Ana’s. Both alternatives require the final named print button; sign-in never prints. H settles login sharing only, not
storage, expiry or delayed updates across accounts.
Cancel
Example only · no printing
Dashboard without a device profile. H is a proposal only. Storage, expiry/reset, late requests, device Invoice memory and portable receipt holding stay open. Phone Equipment follows A796.
Static drawings, no runtime or paper evidence.
